behavior: Requesting java_completion in a scope whose real completion count exceeds the configured cap returns exactly cap items, marked truncated:true with total equal to the true pre-cut count — never a silently shortened list without a total, and never the full uncapped set.
rationale: Only observable by a real completion round-trip through the real JDT LS against a fixture whose member count exceeds the configured cap — the matrix's e2e_scenario technique for integration [INV-TOOL-3]; falsifies an implementation that returns the uncapped list or cuts without reporting the true total.
